verdict.rationale: Coinbase's first-party docs name an official Bazaar MCP server that lets an MCP-compatible agent discover x402 services through tool calls. That is a real, product-provided way to connect an agent, but its documented scope covers only service discovery. missing for 10: setup/connection instructions, a documented tool list, MCP-driven payment execution, auth details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Let an MCP-compatible agent discover services with tool calls.
or via the Bazaar MCP server as tool calls.
Getting discovered makes your endpoint available to tens of thousands of agents through CDP APIs, the Bazaar MCP server, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
